title: Resolution declaring April 28 as Willie Colón Day
summary: This resolution declares April 28 as Willie Colón Day in New York City to honor the South Bronx-born trombonist, bandleader, composer and producer who helped pioneer salsa music. It cites his decades-long career including the album Siembra and collaborations with Héctor Lavoe and Rubén Blades, and notes his death on February 21, 2026 at age 75.
